metadata.description: Claude Café — the plugin that puts a maid on shift.

plugins.name: cafe
plugins.description: Claude Café in one plugin — puts a maid on shift at session start (pick one with CLAUDE_MAID, or none to go off-duty) plus the liveliness layer (time-aware greeting, mood-marker cue, per-turn time).

plugins.name: cc-maid
plugins.description: Experimental pixel maid panel for Claude Code. Gives the agent a visible Kotone portrait and an expression tool. Requires function hooks.
